balls.text: superbly bowled, right in the blockhole, Hasaranga digs it out and they scamper one - Madhwal thinks about throwing at the non-striker's but decides to keep his powder dry, which means RCB fall short of 200 despite that monster stand between du Plessis and Maxwell
pitched up, not quite yorker length but the batter can only dig it out towards mid-off
decent yorker, 139kph on the stumps, Hasaranga opens the face and slices to deep third
full toss, dumped down the ground, back over the bowler's head for a couple as long-on runs across
aims for the blockhole again, 136kph and swung out to deep square leg for a single
slings down a full, fast, straight delivery, squirted off the pads
full, wide and slashed for four! Thick-edged between keeper and short third for a welcome boundary
slower ball wide of off, Jadhav can't connect with a heave across the line
wide full toss, steered through backward point! Misses the mark by some distance and Hasaranga just manages to get enough on it to beat deep third
slower ball in the channel, another swing and a miss
goes full and wide at 141kph, Hasaranga is nowhere near connecting

dug in wide of off, pulled leg side... but he holes out! Looks like an offcutter from Jordan, and DK can't get enough through his pull shot, picking out the man in the deep. A handy cameo but he's fallen at a bad time for RCB. First wicket in blue for Jordan
pushed through flat on the stumps, 101kph and Karthik's sweep finds deep backward square leg
fired down on leg, flicks the pad through to the keeper
full toss, collared over deep midwicket! Kartikeya gets this wrong and is munched into the stands. DK going Donkey Kong styles out there
flighted, spins on leg stump, Kishan is claiming the catch. Not given, think it just deflected off the pad
tossed up and drilled through the covers! Goes deep and throws the hands to smear four more
jumps well across his stumps, Kartikeya goes straight... shovelled past short fine leg! Manufactures the angle, and gets plenty of bat on it
pace off, short of a length outside off, dabbed towards backward point... gets through for a couple
pace off outside off, Jadhav swipes. Maybe an edge on that, but it didn't carry

foxed by the slower ball, ballooned into the Mumbai sky... but Green shells it! Should have been a simple take, jogging in from long-on, but it pops straight out of the hands as he settles under it. Rohit is aghast
pitched up and slammed through extra! Full outside off, 140kph and Karthik creams a drive beyond the flying David
pace off wide of the stumps again, this time he cuts behind point, opens the face to get it into the gap. Well stopped by Madhwal on the run
length in the channel, decent slower ball from Jordan and DK can't connect
over the wicket, flat outside off, looked almost like a seam-up delivery... dabbed past short third but the fielder gets something on it to prevent four
lobbed up outside off, punched to the covers sweeper
round the wicket, SLA on the stumps and straightening... there's an appeal for lbw as DK sweeps and misses. Replay shows he got outside the line
tossed up and Jadhav nurdles off his pads to short midwicket
fired into the pitch, DK flat-bats a single to deep midwicket
loopy wristspinner, Karthik stretches out, wallops a full toss out to deep square leg! Into the gap, one-bounce four
fired in full and straight, dug out towards midwicket
full and thumped down the ground, DK completely under-clubs this... and it's nowhere near carrying to Jordan at long-on
full and pushed towards mid-off coming across
pitched up and driven through the covers for one
short, wide and clubbed! Connects with a meaty cut, flayed past point for four first ball

taken at the third attempt! Du Plessis attempts to ramp this from wide of off stump, miscues towards short fine leg, where the sub fielder Vishnu Vinod juggles the ball once... twice... but holds on! Looked like a slower ball and Faf couldn't generate the required power. Big wicket for MI
100kph slider on leg stump, jabbed out to deep midwicket
pushed across the bows, Faf lets it go
tossed up outside off from over the wicket, driven through the covers

bowled 'im! Kartikeya slides one through Lomror. This is a stock fingerspinner at good pace, Lomror again drops back but only manages to deflect the ball into his leg stump. Two wickets in as many overs for Mumbai
turning into the left-hander, cramping him for room. Lomror chops and inside edge into the turf
angled across, 91kph outside off stump, cut for a single to the cover sweeper
over the wicket, flat delivery outside leg, du Plessis clips off his pads
short of a length, pace off again and Faf flaps it down to long-off
round the wicket, speared in full at 133kph, du Plessis works behind square on the leg side for two
over the wicket, short outside off and swatted on the pull through midwicket

Maxi gone, slogged to deep midwicket! The slower ball works this time for Behrendorff, ending a 120-run mauling for the third wicket. Knuckler from the Aussie southpaw and Maxwell dragged it to the man in the deep, Wadhera holding on to this one as he tumbles backwards
pace off, but Maxwell finds the gap... steps away and slices to deep backward point! Lovely use of the hands to glide it behind the sweeper
full on the stumps and flicked through midwicket
reverse-clobbered over cover! Again Maxwell is messing with the MI attack. Flattish legbreak on the stumps, Maxi shuffles around and hoicks the ball for a one-bounce four
angling in with the arm again, swished out to deep midwicket
pushed through at 94kph, skidding into the back pad as he goes back outside leg
flatter outside off, prodded to cover
flighted, and smacked back... hang time down the ground! Du Plessis clears the front leg and smokes this a long way back over the rope towards the sightscreen
looped up on off stump, Maxwell heaves down the ground, lands the ball short of long-on for one
full on off, Maxwell makes room to hammer this back, Jordan gets a hand down in his follow through
reverse-ramped for six! Gee willikers, that's some shot... Goes back and across, turns the hands around and nonchalantly deflects the ball all the way to deep third
full outside off, driven for a single to the sweeper - and that's fifty for Faf! He's cashing in on that life granted him earlier in the innings
pumped over extra cover! Pitched up but the ball turns into a nice, wide half-volley, du Plessis slapping it away to the left of mid-off
fires this down towards the tramlines... but gets it the wrong side and is wided
wide blockhole again, 137kph and Maxwell opens the face towards deep backward point
full and wide of the off stump, flayed over cover but it's just a single to the sweeper
belts this low full toss to mid-off for a quick single. The over goes for 17, RCB absolutely bossing this at the halfway mark.
reaches out to scythe this wide-worker to third man
drilled to deep cover, took the pace off that time
Faf takes full toll of that full toss! Walks across and scoops this full delivery over fine leg for six. What balance, what composure and hand-eye coordination.
into the blockhole, squeezed to the man at deep midwicket, excellent running to come back for the second.  Oh, dear. Madhwal has overstepped!  Maxwell pumps his fists upon hearing the siren go off.
Yorker-length, scythes this to short third, a misfield gives them a single as Maxwell brings up a 25-ball fifty
welcome Mr Akash! Slips in a full toss down leg and Maxwell flicks him behind square with ridiculous ease
looks to whip it behind square, the ball rolls off the pad to short fine, they'll sneak in a leg bye.
chops wide of point
heaves leg side, gets a thick inside edge to deep square leg
gets away with that half-tracker, Faf rocks back and slaps this pull to wide long-on
drifts into the pads, tucked to deep square
punched to wide long-on

he's belted that in to Navi Mumbai!  Walked down the pitch and waltzed it into the second-tier over long-on. Chawla went length but in walking into the stroke, Maxwell just about managed to get underneath the length and pump it away.
tucked wide of short fine again
googly that skids back into hit him on the pad again, may have got an inside edge in trying to work it through the leg side. Good bowling from PC
it's the slider that skids back into hit the pad as Faf looks to whip it square.
short, cuts to sweeper cover
drifting into middle and leg, tucked to short fine for a quick single
slower ball into the pitch, whipped to deep midwicket
flayed through the line to deep cover, two more
punched to deep point

my word, he's absolutely bludgeoned that into the stands! Stands and admires his shot later. Picks length early, swivels back and pulls him imperiously in front of square. What muscle, what timing. Incredible. Exhilarating.
fuller and closer to the stumps, defended back
welcome, Chris! Maxwell swivels back and helps this up and over backward square leg. 56-metre hit for six there.
whips to square leg for a quick single
Jordan in action once again, Maxwell hits this flat and on the bounce to him at mid-off
pushed to mid-off for a quick single, Jordan in the thick of things again
absolutely drilled through the infield, Jordan runs himself to his left and throws himself full-stretch to save three runs.  Exceptional effort from Jordan

he's hit that with ridiculous ease!  Chawla fires one in at 113kph, Maxwell stands tall and punches it through the line. Jordan gives it chase from mid-off and puts in a belated dive to try and pull its back but ends up parrying it past the hoardings.
reverse-swept for four!  Full'ish on middle, Maxwell changes stance and absolutely belts this over the infield.  One bounce to the ropes.
thumps this into the crowd! Length on middle, Faf lifts him through the line and ends up picking the bones out of that. Sails way over the ropes at long-on.
has a big heave at that, but the ball deflects off the pad past short third.
gets some tickle on that to the fine leg boundary! It was short and angling down, Maxwell was looking to help it away over short fine but ended up getting it a lot finer.
pushed to mid-off, good comeback. Pulled his length back a touch that time.
belted down the ground! Length and slanting away, Maxwell shuffles across and hits that ramrod straight.
into the blockhole, squeezed to mid-off
tucks him up with an into-the-pitch delivery, defended to point
punched to deep point
gets into a tangle trying to get inside the line and ramp that. Green bowled this full and on off to hit Faf on the body. Short fine was in, so he tried to hit it up and over.
one bounce over mid-on! That's absolutely muscled. Too short from Green, Faf stands and delivers.
better from Green. Length on middle to tuck up Faf, defended
strays down leg and Faf picks him off his pads to the square leg boundary. Easy
movement and bounce to beat the inside edge and hit Maxwell on the midriff. Top over
right behind the line as he defends back
what a shot that! Just a punch between cover and point; it races away on this fast outfield. Hit it hard into the turf, the ball bounced away into the gap for four.
late movement back in off a length, defended

What was Rawat doing?  Looks to scoop but Behrendorff bowls this a touch wide, the extra movement away means Rawat is now forced to abandon his shot and try to steer it instead but ends up getting a top-edge as Cam Green running back from slip gobbles it up with his big hands.
sashays down the pitch and slaps this over cover! Rawat gets into the act this time.
flatter on middle, pushed to cover
hammered over mid-off! Chawla goes full, Faf backs away and hits him cleanly. Two bounces to the rope.
smashed to the point boundary! Backs away to free his arms and belts this into the gap.
beaten by one that skids through! Faf looks to slap this through cover but it's a lot fuller for him to play the cross-batted shot.
pushed through quicker on a length outside off, Faf goes back and across as he defends
tossed up on middle, Rawat slog-sweeps to deep square. Not where he intended.
floats it full on the stumps, Rawat taps it down the pitch and scampers a run to mid-on.

big appeal for caught behind, but the umpire is unmoved. Rohit reviews immediately, I suspect Kohli's got a big edge on that.  Yup, yup, he has!  Kohli was looking to give him the charge and heave it across the line but ends up nicking through to Ishan Kishan. What a big, big wicket that. Drama early on at the Wankede.
dropped at midwicket by Wadhera!  Full toss on the pads, Faf flicks this uppishly, bursts through his hands. Rohit can't believe it, he's livid. Big, big moment.
wrists this length ball to deep square, Kohli's away, RCB are away
beauty. Gets this to slant across on off, Kohli plays inside the line as this zips past the outside edge
short of length on middle, Kohli's right on top of the bounce as he defends back
hammered over the cover boundary, MI win at a canter! Wadhera smokes this flat for six to bring up his half-century and send his team third in the table
dug in short, pace off and Wadhera can't connect with his pull
slower ball, dipping full toss on the stumps. Helped to long-on
length ball in the channel, Green steers calmly through the covers
chipped straight to long-off! Vyshak takes two in two. Full outside off, pace off again and David picks out Maxwell running in for a simple catch. Drama? Probably not quite yet

slower ball, swung to leg... but it won't clear the man! Vyshak claims the wicket of SKY but not before the damage has been done. Couldn't get enough power on this one and it plops well inside the rope to be taken safely by Jadhav. SKY walks off, having made his highest IPL score, to a rousing ovation from the Wankhede faithful
another full toss, lifted into the second tier! SKY dances across and flips this high over deep backward square. Just like tossing pancakes
sliced up and over backward point, sits back and helicopters the ball up and over the man inside the ring
full toss, honked for six... and a free hit coming! SKY sees it like a beachball and splices a pull all the way over fine leg. This is slipping away - quite literally - from RCB
full length outside off, driven down the ground
flat outside off, maybe the googly, punched to long-on
hockey shot behind square on the leg side, Wadhera gets in on the act as he moves across and swipes four more
flat outside off, carved away to the cover sweeper
biggie! Launched over deep square leg! Plants the front foot and hammers a 90m slog-sweep into the stands
flighted, down leg and he sweeps again, this comes off the back of the bat, I think, and runs fine for a couple
slog-swept into the crowd, MI flags are waving! Stretches out and hoicks this up and over the man on the rope at deep backward square leg
dug in with pace off again, Wadhera pulls... and gets a cue-ender into no-man's land at mid-off
slower delivery, plinked into the leg side for a single
full outside off, crunched to the cover sweeper for two - another fifty for SKY, tough start to the tournament but he's definitely back in form now
smoked down the ground! Picks the slower ball and launches it back over long-on, does a little hop after making connection. Brings up the MI 150, too
full, wide and sliced past short third! Slightly ungainly, it was an offcutter in the channel,. came off a thick edge but spins and runs away
wide blockhole with pace off, Suryakumar swipes but fails to connect
fired in full and straight, squirted behind square on the leg side
pitched up wide of the stumps, SKY drives with an open face, sliced behind point into the gap! Places the slower ball for another boundary
hits a length, worked into the leg side. Harshal gives chase to prevent two
short and top-edged fine! Clears Hazlewood at short fine leg and then skips away for four more
high full toss, and it disappears to deep third! Wadhera has to take evasive action, the ball clips him on the back of the shoulder and then wrongfoots Rawat. No-ball, more costly extras for RCB
dipping full toss, wide of off and this is dragged out to deep midwicket
pitched up on fifth stump, crunched down to long-off

whirlitzer wrists, four more to fine leg!Short ball, deep in the crease, SKY loves using the pace and going behind square. Not the cleanest connection but he gets it past the man in the ring and it trundles away
gets it away this time, short and with pace on, Suryakumar sits back and ramps the ball casually down to deep third for four
back of a length, 117kph and SKY collapses on to his backside looking to swipe it beyond the keeper. Fails to connect
full length with pace off, clubbed down to long-off
pace off again, Wadhera misses with a hoick across the line. Hazelwood was very keen on the lbw appeal but umpire Sharma shakes his head. Maybe high? Faf not interested in the review
cutter on a length outside off, 128kph and it grips, slides past the outside edge
slower ball, drifts wide of the off-side tramlines
chopped down the ground for one
pushed back, fielded by the bowler to his left
full and plonked into the boundary boards car beyond the boundary! Wadhera has slog-swept this flush into the pitch-side prize promo vehicle, denting the door handle!
floated up full on middle and leg, just gets some bat on his sweep for one
dragged down and battered into the stands! SKY launches this flat towards deep midwicket for six
pushed through outside off, hacked down the ground to long-off
dipping yorker that he squeezes off an inside edge to square leg.
beats him with an off-cutter that keeps a tad low as Wadhera looks to flay this through cover
back-of-the-hand slower delivery outside off, worked to long-on
belts this full toss down the ground to long-on
sways out of the line of this short of length delivery but it's called wide as he sprays it way outside off.
good old French cut for four! Harshal nearly defeats him with a yorker as Wadhera backs away to carve it through cover, gets beaten nearly on the inside edge as the ball races away.
dragged off a thick inside edge to deep midwicket, was looking to hoick across the line even as Harshal went full and wide
works it down to long-on
swept well but straight to deep square. Loaded with risk that, but SKY plays it so well
dropped!  Wadhera absolutely nailed this off the middle, it was coming back hard at Hasaranga, he put his hand out but it just burst through for a single
poor ball, poor grab down leg. Rawat can't get around in time as Hasaranga slips it down. Two more runs
works it down to long-on
chops it into the ground, point comes in to stop that
flatter one on middle, punched to deep midwicket
driven firmly to wide long-off.
Siraj's saved four this time!  Throws himself full stretch to his left to stop this Surya's late dab.
pulled into the gap, excellent work at deep midwicket by Suyash Prabhudesai. Covered 20 yards or so and the put in the dive to intercept the ball. Then parried it to Kohli for the throw. Saved two.

struck on the body as Surya attempts to get inside the line to scoop over short fine. Faf has been taken in by Vyshak's vociferous appeal, he's asked for the DRS.Ball tracking confirms impact as umpire's call. Given not out and it'll remain not out.
width and Surya plays it really late to pick the gap behind point. Lovely timing and placement. Runs continue to torrent for MI. Valiant effort from Wanindu to try and get to the ball
walks into the shot as he tucks this short of length delivery to deep midwicket
deflects off the body to short third. Rawat couldn't stop it despite a dive. Wadhera was through with the pull even before the ball arrived.
dug into the pitch, Surya bunts it wide of midwicket
steered down to square third
overpitched and Wadhera has drilled that through extra cover.
driven to sweeper cover

Kohli's made a right royal mess of it at deep midwicket. Ran around the ropes to stop this flick, went one-handed to try and flick the ball back in but missed it completely. What should've been two is a boundary.
tardy effort from Harshal at short fine, costs them an extra run. Neat flick for two.
slips this length ball down leg, wide called as the batter misses the tickle
slower ball, a loopy one at that, Wadhera through with the swing even before the ball arrived, beaten.
gets pumped into the stands the moment he goes pace! This was dug in short, Wadhera rocks back and pulls him over deep square.
short of length on middle and leg, defended to short midwicket

run-out chance at the bowler's end, SKY dives and just about makes it! Surya nearly gets a leading edge back to the bowler, but sees an opportunity to pinch a run as the bowler recovers on his followthrough and takes off. Just made it in time.
bowls a cutter into the pitch to begin, Surya gets one off the inside edge into the leg side as he tries to push it through cover

big appeal for lbw as Rohit is struck on the pad as he steps out to work it to the leg side. RCB have reviewed the not-out call. No bat involved as Ultra Edge confirms. The only point of contention is ball tracking and it  comes back to show all three reds.  Rohit is gone, what an inspired appeal that. Rohit is gone and it's a double-strike that has brought RCB back into the game.
whips it to deep square to get off the mark

what a comeback, Hasaranga gives RCB some breathing space! Bowls one through quicker, the ball skids through on a length and cramps Kishan for room as he looks to slap it through the off side, gets the thinnest of edges that Rawat pouches superbly.
bowls the wrong'un but it doesn't matter because Kishan gets underneath the length in stepping out. Clean swing to clear wide long-on.
flatter and fuller around off, pushed into the off side, Rohit refuses the single immediately
belts down the ground! Hasaranga bowls full, Kishan backs away and swings cleanly.
good line, tight line around off, Rohit defends to point. Good comeback after the early assault in the over. MI motoring along nonetheless
slower and fuller on the stumps, works it straight to midwicket
sees Rohit backing away and follows him, Rohit through the pull early as the ball deflects towards slip off his thigh
flat-bats a pull but the timing is off, just short of Faf at mid-on, they'll scamper a run.

skids one off a length on middle and leg, Kishan's hit on the thigh pad as he looks to tuck it square. Kohli with some nifty footwork to try and hit the stumps at the striker's end, and  had he hit, Kishan may have been out.
monster hit! Made such sweet connection that you knew it was six the moment he hit it. Heaved into the top tier at deep square leg.
slower and fuller on leg stump, Kishan is stuck on the pad as he looks to flick. They'll take a leg bye though as the ball rolls into the off side.
spears in a fiery bouncer but it's way over Ishan's head as he tries to upper cut, excellent take by Anuj Rawat who has got the gloves tonight.
pulls his length back but it doesn't matter. Kishan takes him on with the pull from outside off and clears deep backward square leg.
that's a terrific stroke, Kishan on the charge. Makes room to allow himself the free swing as he butchers this full delivery over the long-on boundary
looks to blast this pull in front of square but the ball hurries on to take the toe-end and roll back
bludgeoned that on the up, but straight to extra cover
skiddy short of length delivery angling into middle from wide of the crease, Rohit turns it into the leg side for a single

lofted over the infield, one bounce to the long-on boundary.  Not all that bad a delivery, length on middle and leg, but Kishan's fast hands and decisiveness makes the shot possible. Where others would've perhaps looked to tuck it through midwicket, he went down town and ended up getting full value for his shot.

whips this through midwicket. This wasn't timed as well as he would've liked but the outfield is so fast that once you cross the infield, it's a foregone conclusion that it'll speed away to the fence.
uses the pace to run it down to Harshal at third man
uses the pace to steer this nicely along to third man where Vyshak runs around swiftly and puts in a dive to save at least one.
short-arm jabs this pull to deep square. Hazlewood wasn't thrown off by that first stroke and went hard length again.
steps out and absolutely flat-bats him over mid-on for four. Some way to shred two ducks
chops it to slip as he tries to steer this behind point. Excellent comeback from Siraj to close out the first over.
not all that short enough to pull, Kishan goes through with the shot and is beaten. Was also cramped for room that time.
gets this short of length delivery to rear up as he slants it across, Kishan gets on top of the bounce and bunts it to backward point
slants one across on a length, Kishan lets it go
much better. Full and shaping into middle, driven firmly to mid-off
off the mark with a boundary and it's a gift down leg. Kishan simply tickles this off his hip to the fine leg fence.
